items.author: nikkinightly.bsky.social
items.context: The alt text for Cyberia 2 was mistakenly written wrong. It's Cyberia not Siberia. The first game was released on MS-DOS and that's how I played it. The second game was released on MS-DOS and windows. I don't remember which version I had.
items.text: Cyberia on MS-DOS is a great memory. Those pre-rendered cutscenes felt like the future back then.

items.author: thejackdias.bsky.social
items.context: Really want to get a old CRT for old games, films and anime. Ideally with hook ups for a PC. Browsing marketplace for horribly scalped mid tier screens is so depressing though... $400 for some crappy dell mointor???
items.text: Marketplace prices for CRTs are rough. Thrift stores and local recycling centers sometimes have them for much less, so worth a check before paying a scalper price.
items.verify: Общий совет про CRT в комиссионках: фактов и цен нет, но проверьте, что вам нравится тон.
